## Professional profile
Nikunj Khitha is a Full-Stack GenAI Engineer focused on productionizing Generative AI systems. His work centers on Knowledge Graph RAG, tenant-scoped MCP access, LLM gateways, internal AI infrastructure, backend platforms, and polished product delivery.

Core areas:
- Knowledge Graph RAG systems and retrieval infrastructure
- Multi-agent workflows, MCP servers, and tenant-scoped tool access
- LLM gateways, OpenCode workflows, and AI automation infrastructure
- Backend services, APIs, and platform infrastructure
- Full-stack product engineering with modern web stacks

## Featured projects
1. CodeNex: AI Builder
   - Live URL: https://www.codenex.dev/
   - URL: https://github.com/Nikunj2003/Codenex-backend-v1
   - Summary: AI codegen SaaS that turns natural-language prompts into full React applications using Spring Boot and Spring AI, with SSE streaming, MinIO/NFS persistence, and Kubernetes preview pods.
   - Stack signals: Java, Spring Boot, Spring AI, React, TypeScript, SSE, Kubernetes, MinIO, Stripe.

2. CodeNex AI API Proxy
   - URL: https://github.com/Nikunj2003/codenex-ai-api-proxy
   - Summary: OpenAI-compatible AI gateway with provider abstraction, multi-account load balancing, health-aware fallbacks, Redis-backed response caching, streaming support, and operational controls.
   - Stack signals: Go, Gin, Redis, PostgreSQL, React, OpenAI-compatible APIs.

3. Serenify
   - Live URL: https://serenify.codenex.dev/
   - Source URL: https://github.com/Nikunj2003/Serenify

   - Stack signals: React, TypeScript, Supabase, pgvector, Gemini AI, Vercel.

4. CodeNex Images

5. Resume Fit — CodeNex

6. LLaMa MCP Streamlit
